content.short: Elliptic provides tools and compliance structures to keep wallets and crypto assets safe.
content.description: Founded in 2013 by Dr. James Smith, Dr. Adam Joyce, and Dr. Tom Robinson, Elliptic was created to close the security and compliance gaps surrounding cryptocurrency assets. Organizations can engage Elliptic to investigate crimes involving cryptocurrency tokens and assets, including NFTs. Developers can leverage Elliptic's tools to observe how assets move across wallets and blockchains. With hundreds of compliance cases handled, Elliptic aims to make the crypto ecosystem safer for everyone.
